title: tny settings.json
description: User configuration for ~/.tny/settings.json. Command-line flags and environment variables override these defaults.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors for validation and completion.

provider.description: Native HTTP profile: openai, codex, grok, or a configured OpenAI-compatible gateway.

model.description: Default model globally or by provider. Command-line --model wins.

models.description: Models last selected for individual providers. tny updates this map after successful use.

optimise.description: Independent prompt optimisation defaults. TNY_OPTIMISE_PROVIDER, TNY_OPTIMISE_MODEL and TNY_OPTIMISE_TIMEOUT override these; explicit optimisation options win. Project optimise.timeout_seconds overrides the user timeout default.

effort.description: Reasoning effort globally or by provider. Canonical values: off, light, medium, high, xhigh, max, default; provider-advertised values are also accepted.

fast.description: Paid fast tier globally or by provider. Unsupported providers fail clearly.

image_input.description: Conversation image input per provider: true means configured, unverified (tny never checks a live entitlement); false refuses --image, read_image and attachments for that provider. Absent providers stay unknown and keep their existing explicit image behavior. Keys are canonical provider selectors. Image generation is independent and never gated by this map.

tools.description: Built-in tool profile for the native OpenAI-compatible loop. Environment TNY_TOOLS wins. Ignored by libtny, wasm.

last_provider.description: Provider most recently used. tny maintains this field; provider takes precedence when explicitly configured.

permission.description: Persistent permission rules. Tool/category keys map patterns to allow, deny, or ask.

web_search_command.description: Shell command template that provides web_search. Every {query} or {{query}} placeholder receives the percent-encoded query. The expanded command runs through the terminal tool path (workspace cwd, --ssh remote runner, 60 s timeout, bounded output). When both keys are set, web_search_command wins over web_search_url. Not available in wasm.

web_search_url.description: URL template that provides web_search. Every {query} or {{query}} placeholder receives the percent-encoded query; fetched over HTTP(S) like web_fetch.

web_search_model.description: Supported Codex model for provider-independent search-only requests. Does not change the conversation model or builtin Codex inline hosted search.

web_search_timeout_seconds.description: Total Codex search-service deadline including token refresh and streamed response, in seconds.

mcp.description: MCP client options. Import from other harnesses is off by default.

import_from.description: Opt-in list of harnesses whose documented user/project MCP configs tny may read. Empty/absent means no foreign files are opened.
